ai-search-crawler-policy.question: Can I allow AI search discovery while blocking model-training crawlers?
ai-search-crawler-policy.answer: Use separate rules for each provider’s documented search, model-development, and user-requested fetch mechanisms. A training-crawler block does not automatically block the other two. Start with the outcome you want, then merge the appropriate named groups into your existing robots.txt and verify the deployed response. The comparison here retains its July 2026 documentation cutoff; revisit provider definitions before changing policy. Permission to crawl does not guarantee indexing, training, or a citation.

paths.label: Choose the allowed use
paths.description: Separate search, model development, and a user opening a URL.

paths.label: Build the provider rules
paths.description: Merge named crawler groups without discarding existing site rules.

paths.label: Check what reached the server
paths.description: Compare deployed policy with requests and provider identity evidence.

atlas-building-an-evidence-console.question: How do I tell whether an audit finding is backed by captured evidence?
atlas-building-an-evidence-console.answer: Follow the finding back to its captured artifact, retrieval conditions, interpretation, and review decision. Keep missing measurements visible: saved JavaScript data is not proof that a browser rendered it. Atlas illustrates that workflow with a bounded source sample and a pinned code revision. Its tests establish behavior at that revision; the retained two-page capture establishes only what those requests returned. Neither establishes coverage or outcomes for an entire site.

paths.label: Inspect the captured sample
paths.description: See the retained requests and the limits of the two-page corpus.

paths.label: Separate source from rendering
paths.description: Check which observations were measured and which were unavailable.

paths.label: Trace a finding to a decision
paths.description: Follow evidence, rule evaluation, review, and export.

audit-findings-derived-records.question: What must I save so another person can reproduce an audit finding?
audit-findings-derived-records.answer: Save the original artifact, a typed observation, the rule version and inputs, the scoped finding, and the reviewer’s decision as separate linked records. Give each layer a stable identifier and timestamp. A later rule or correction should append a new interpretation rather than overwrite what was captured. Keep confidence, unavailable evidence, and recommended actions explicit so an exported finding still explains how it was reached and what it cannot establish.

paths.label: Choose the record boundaries
paths.description: Separate captured facts, interpretations, decisions, and recommendations.

paths.label: Make the rule reproducible
paths.description: Retain the exact evaluation inputs and rule version.

paths.label: Preserve gaps through review
paths.description: Export decisions with their evidence lineage and unresolved limits.

canonical-identity-personal-seo.question: How do I make my website, résumé, and public profiles describe the same person?
canonical-identity-personal-seo.answer: Inventory the profiles and documents people can actually find, then choose an authoritative homepage and current résumé. Reconcile names, roles, dates, and links against that record before adding more pages. Use sameAs for profiles representing the same identity, rather than every page that mentions you. Retain dated historical context where appropriate. Consistent publication signals help people and crawlers reconcile records; they do not give you control over a search engine’s identity presentation.

paths.label: Find conflicting records
paths.description: Inventory discoverable profiles, documents, names, and dated roles.

paths.label: Choose identity links
paths.description: Distinguish equivalent profiles from references and unrelated entities.

paths.label: Set a résumé policy
paths.description: Choose the current document and preserve useful historical context.

canonicalization-graph-consistency.question: Why can a page have a canonical tag and still fail a migration audit?
canonicalization-graph-consistency.answer: A tag can point to one URL while redirects, internal links, and the sitemap point elsewhere. Model those signals together and test whether eligible duplicates converge on one stable, indexable representative. Look for loops, competing endpoints, and targets that redirect again or cannot be indexed. A canonical declaration expresses a preference; it does not override contradictory behavior. Run the same checks on captured production responses, because a correct template does not establish what the deployed route serves.

paths.label: Map conflicting signals
paths.description: Represent redirects, canonicals, sitemap membership, and links together.

paths.label: Find loops and competing targets
paths.description: Identify paths that fail to reach one stable representative.

paths.label: Verify the deployed migration
paths.description: Check the final responses and their aligned publication signals.

crawl-frontier-state-machine.question: How do I keep a crawler from losing URLs, retrying forever, or overwhelming one host?
crawl-frontier-state-machine.answer: Treat every discovered URL as a tracked item with explicit admission, scheduling, fetch, retry, and completion states. Preserve the original URL separately from its comparison key, schedule work by origin, and bound retries and expansion into traps. Record why a URL was delayed, rejected, or abandoned. That makes an incomplete crawl explainable and replayable, while a queue containing only pending URLs cannot account for all the work that disappeared from it.

paths.label: Define URL identity
paths.description: Keep discovery evidence separate from normalized comparison keys.

paths.label: Schedule politely by origin
paths.description: Apply host-level timing and capacity constraints before fetching.

paths.label: Explain failures and omissions

hidden-financing-hardware-startups.question: Who ultimately pays for a hardware startup’s fleet or factory?
hidden-financing-hardware-startups.answer: Trace who supplies the cash, who owns the asset, who must repay or deliver, and who absorbs losses if utilization or resale value falls. Debt, leases, customer prepayments, and public support can reduce upfront equity needs while creating different obligations. The five dated cases here illustrate those structures rather than one universal funding model. A financing announcement alone cannot establish asset title, recourse, collateral value, or the amount of capital investors can safely recover.

paths.description: Distinguish company funding, physical assets, and project cash flows.

paths.label: Compare actual financing mechanics
paths.description: Identify repayment, rental, delivery, and conditional-support obligations.

paths.description: Ask what happens when assets sit idle or sell for less than expected.

how-airlines-borrow-against-loyalty-prog.question: What does an airline actually pledge when it borrows against a loyalty program?
how-airlines-borrow-against-loyalty-prog.answer: It pledges designated commercial receipts and related contractual rights, rather than treating members’ miles as bank deposits. Card partners pay for mileage credits and marketing benefits; cash collection, revenue recognition, award fulfillment, and debt repayment follow different clocks. In the documented AAdvantage structure, controlled collection accounts, collateral, and reserves protect lenders before surplus reaches the airline. Partner cash receipts, accounting revenue, and profit therefore cannot be substituted for one another when valuing the program or its debt.

paths.description: See what card issuers purchase and which obligations the airline assumes.

paths.label: Reconcile cash and revenue
paths.description: Separate immediate receipts from deferred travel awards and marketing revenue.

paths.label: Read the lender’s claim
paths.description: Trace pledged receipts, collateral, reserves, and the payment waterfall.

internal-links-directed-retrieval-graph.question: How do I find important pages that internal links fail to reach?
internal-links-directed-retrieval-graph.answer: Start with the intended entry pages and an independent inventory of the pages that should exist. Build a directed graph of crawlable links, retaining each link’s label, placement, and source or rendered state. Then examine unreachable pages, excessive depth, and routes dependent on a single parent. A page absent from one crawl is not automatically an orphan: scope and capture failures must be checked before recommending new links. Repairs should improve a reader’s route as well as graph reachability.

jane-street-exact-search-solver-verifica.question: How do I check that a puzzle solver’s winning answer is valid?
jane-street-exact-search-solver-verifica.answer: Recompute the submitted route’s moves, clues, scoring, and constraints from the puzzle specification instead of trusting the search routine’s final score. In the retained July 2026 solve, arithmetic pruning reduced the schedule search before geometric segments were explored; the resulting 33,609 matched Jane Street’s published solution. The verifier still shares helpers with the solver, so agreement establishes a checked result within that implementation, rather than a fully independent proof of correctness.

raw-html-rendered-dom-evidence.question: Which version of a JavaScript page should an SEO audit trust?
raw-html-rendered-dom-evidence.answer: Capture both the HTTP response and the rendered DOM, because they answer different questions and either can contain information the other lacks. Preserve the browser environment, requests, timing, errors, and completion rule with the rendered snapshot. When content differs, first distinguish an application defect from blocked resources, consent, authentication, timeout, or capture failure. A screenshot or empty source response alone cannot establish what a particular crawler successfully retrieved and processed.

replayable-traces-ai-agent-evaluation.question: How do I tell whether an agent improvement is reliable rather than a lucky run?
replayable-traces-ai-agent-evaluation.answer: Define the task, initial environment, and success conditions before running the agent, then retain the actions and resulting state as a replayable trace. Grade the final outcome separately from the path: a correct answer can conceal an unacceptable action. Repeat comparable trials, record cost and failure patterns, and test regressions before promoting a change. One successful transcript cannot establish reliability, and a model-based grader needs its own validation against the behavior you intend to measure.

robots-txt-courtesy-not-access-control.question: Will robots.txt keep a private page out of search and prevent access?
robots-txt-courtesy-not-access-control.answer: No. Robots.txt asks cooperating crawlers which paths to request; it does not authenticate a visitor or deny access. Google can still list a disallowed URL discovered elsewhere. For a public page that should not be indexed, use a supported noindex instruction that the crawler can retrieve. For private content, enforce authentication and authorization at the server. Test those boundaries separately, and treat a claimed bot User-Agent as a claim rather than verified identity.

software-buyout-boom-2020-2022-exit-audi.question: Did the 2020–2022 software buyouts fully exit, or just generate some liquidity?

In the August 17, 2026 audit, none of the 25 reviewed take-privates met the study’s clean-realization definition. That finding does not mean every investment lost money. Announcement values, enterprise value, sponsor equity invested, and cash returned measure different things; public evidence does not reconstruct a complete fund return.

sqlite-crawl-pipelines.question: How can concurrent crawl workers save results without losing the audit trail?
sqlite-crawl-pipelines.answer: Keep each fetch attempt as an immutable record and serialize writes through a bounded transaction boundary. Acknowledge a result only after its transaction commits; use stable keys and idempotent writes to make retries safe. Separate attempts from the current-page projection so late renders or repeated requests do not erase history. WAL can help readers coexist with a writer, but it does not turn SQLite into a database with unrestricted concurrent writers.

structured-data-without-content-drift.question: How do I stop JSON-LD, the visible page, and the sitemap from disagreeing?
structured-data-without-content-drift.answer: Derive them from one typed publication record with stable identity, dates, and source provenance. Validate the meaning shared across those projections, not just whether each output parses. A valid JSON-LD object can still describe a different author, URL, or date from the visible page. Treat changes to that record as publication changes, regenerate every dependent output, and test the resulting agreements before release rather than repairing each representation independently.

technical-seo-migration-release-gates.question: What should I verify before changing article URLs?
technical-seo-migration-release-gates.answer: Inventory the meaningful old URLs and approve a specific outcome for each: retained content, an equivalent destination, or deliberate removal. Test redirects, final status, canonical URLs, indexability, internal links, and sitemap membership together. A successful build cannot establish that production serves those outcomes. Keep a launch baseline and repeat the checks against live responses so a routing defect can be distinguished from a later indexing transition or a change in search demand.

technical-seo-public-data-infrastructure.question: Where should I look when a page is visible but downstream data is wrong?
technical-seo-public-data-infrastructure.answer: Trace the publication pipeline one boundary at a time: route and HTTP response, browser rendering, semantic extraction, structured record, and exported result. Preserve the input, output, identity, and transformation at each boundary so you can locate where information changed or disappeared. Being visible in a browser does not prove an extractor or search system received the same record. Report unavailable measurements and freshness limits before presenting the downstream output as authoritative.

the-ai-megawatt.question: How many GPUs does a one-gigawatt AI data center contain?
the-ai-megawatt.answer: There is no single conversion until you know whether the gigawatt means a grid request, facility capacity, IT power, or average consumption. The reference model here converts 1,000 MW of facility capacity into 402,574 B300 GPUs using its stated NVL72 rack assumptions, PUE of 1.145, and 10% external IT overhead. That is a scenario, not an observed fleet. Apply overhead at the correct boundary, then distinguish installed capacity from utilization and useful work.

the-first-ai-managers.question: Has an AI-run shop demonstrated profit without hidden human support?
the-first-ai-managers.answer: The July 2026 review documents agents making real operating decisions, but it does not establish audited, fully burdened profit from a general-purpose model running a business end to end. Compare the live shops with pilots and simulations separately. Include human staffing, setup, supplier assistance, rent, failures, and continuing intervention before treating reported revenue or operating surplus as autonomous profit. The useful question is which decisions the agent controls and which costs and responsibilities remain human.

us-rare-earth-magnet-manufacturing-capac.question: Can announced U.S. rare-earth magnet capacity replace imports?
us-rare-earth-magnet-manufacturing-capac.answer: Only compare qualified output that can serve the relevant products with a demand denominator measured on the same basis. The August 2026 audit separates commercial shipments, ramping lines, construction, and future announcements rather than adding them all as available supply. Magnet grade, geometry, coating, qualification, and upstream material constraints affect what customers can actually buy. Nameplate tonnes alone therefore cannot establish import replacement, particularly when announcements describe different stages or products.

viralbench-codex-agent-harness.question: How should I improve a ViralBench agent without mistaking luck for a better system?
viralbench-codex-agent-harness.answer: Retain the run’s state and action trace, reproduce failures offline, and give Codex a bounded engineering task with independent review. Reserve live comparisons for controlled experiments with defined measurement windows and uncertainty. A leaderboard result measures the configured system, including its tools, memory, budgets, and environment. This article proposes that harness from a code audit; it does not report a deployed harness or measured improvement, so the proposal itself is not evidence of performance gains.

waymo-hardware-financing.question: Does Waymo’s fundraising reveal who owns its vehicles or bears fleet losses?
waymo-hardware-financing.answer: No. The disclosed investment rounds establish company funding, while public disclosures leave important fleet-level title, lease, recourse, and residual-value questions unresolved. The article’s visible case is parent-supported, equity-heavy financing; its leasing and asset-backed structures are explicit counterfactual models. To assess fleet economics, identify who pays for vehicles and sensors, who controls utilization, and who absorbs idle capacity, repairs, or resale losses. Do not convert a fundraising total into a measured fleet balance sheet.

west-campus-student-housing.answer: Compare the whole contract term and included services, rather than treating a quoted installment as ordinary monthly rent. The study’s Callaway example has ten payments, with meals and furnishings changing the comparison; parking, insurance, guarantees, and reletting terms can add obligations. For the property’s economics, keep operating income separate from debt service and investor returns. what-happens-when-an-index-decides-a-com.question: How much new buying does a company’s index inclusion actually cause?
what-happens-when-an-index-decides-a-com.answer: Begin with the index’s eligibility rules, inclusion date, and target weight, then identify assets that actually replicate it. Benchmark-linked assets are not all forced buyers. Estimate the net ownership change after overlap, source-index selling, existing positions, and execution choices, rather than multiplying a headline AUM number by weight. Rebalancing can concentrate trading at the effective close, but inclusion alone does not establish a lasting price premium or a permanent reduction in capital costs.

where-online-returns-actually-go.question: Why can a retailer refund me and still tell me to keep the item?
where-online-returns-actually-go.answer: The refund decision and the decision to retrieve the product are separate. For an eligible item, retrieval only makes economic sense when the recoverable value exceeds shipping, handling, inspection, and other expected costs. A returned product may be restocked, sold open-box, refurbished, liquidated, donated, or disposed of depending on its condition and constraints. Positive recovery reduces a loss relative to abandonment; it does not mean the original sale remains profitable or that environmental reuse was verified.

A local office, founder’s name, or locally managed staff does not establish local equity ownership. In the July 2026 map, Radiant connects to T3 Services Group and Riverside. Keep those layers separate when comparing contractors, and leave the chain unresolved when a primary record does not support the next ownership step.

who-owns-texas-toll-roads.question: Who owns Texas toll roads, and is NTTA a private company?

why-texas-toll-roads-stay-tolled.question: Why do tolls continue after a road’s construction cost has been paid?
why-texas-toll-roads-stay-tolled.answer: Recovering construction cost is different from retiring a road’s debt, retiring a pooled system’s debt, or ending the legal power to charge tolls. texas-property-tax-business-underwriting.question: What can change a Texas business property-tax budget?
texas-property-tax-business-underwriting.answer: Reconstruct each asset and taxing unit, keeping market, appraised and taxable values separate.
